title: bug: setting an epic to ARCHIVED through moe.update_epic or the board's /ws UPDATE_EPIC (both plugins' epic status combo offers Archived) skips every guard of moe.archive_epic, so in-flight rows keep running under an ARCHIVED epic, its tasks are never archived, and workers can no longer file cards into it
description:
Filed by defect hunt #12 (task-f6f0b580, architect-1dd28c7c). Both hunt lanes found it independently. Reproduced at moe/work-2026-10-24 f159784e; the files are unchanged at cbae6070.

PROBLEM (packages/moe-daemon/src/):
- moe.archive_epic:
  - refuses while any task is PLANNING, AWAITING_APPROVAL or WORKING (archiveEpic.ts:12, :61);
  - applies archive_task's holder rule to held BLOCKED rows (:15-28);
  - archives every task with a TASK_ARCHIVED event.
- moe.update_epic passes status through without any of those rules: updateEpic.ts:90 `if (params.status !== undefined) updates.status = params.status;` goes to StateManager.updateEpic, whose validateEpicUpdates accepts 'ARCHIVED' (state/validators.ts:587). Its inputSchema enum leaves ARCHIVED out (updateEpic.ts:38), but McpAdapter does not enforce schemas, and docs/MCP_SERVER.md:1908 lists ARCHIVED.
- /ws UPDATE_EPIC (server/WebSocketServer.ts:664-674) hands the plugin's updates straight to state.updateEpic.
  - JetBrains EpicDetailDialog.kt:31 offers ARCHIVED in its status combo, saved via MoeCommandSender.kt:104-118.
  - VS Code EpicDetailPanel.ts:291 offers Archived.
- Effect: only the epic's status flips.
  - In-flight rows keep running.
  - The board snapshot drops the epic but keeps its tasks (WebSocketServer.ts:397-398).
  - create_task into the epic is refused with "Epic is ARCHIVED: … un-archive the epic first" (taskStore.ts:307), so a worker cannot file a bug: card into its own epic.
  - The epic's tasks are never archived, so their dependents are never released.
- Related: the shelved row task-75eae924 called ARCHIVED invalid for update_epic. Since then 68a47060 made ARCHIVED a valid create_epic status. So keep ARCHIVED valid and make it safe; do not refuse it outright.

EVIDENCE (git-archive snapshot of f159784e; my re-runs are in /mnt/d/moe-scratch/hunt-f6f0b580/me/):
- /mnt/d/moe-scratch/hunt-f6f0b580/B/zzHuntB_epicArchive.test.ts uses zzHuntB_harness.ts (a real StateManager, McpAdapter and MoeWebSocketServer on an ephemeral port) and sends the exact JetBrains EpicDetailDialog payload. Result: Tests 2 failed | 1 passed (3).
  - ✓ twin: archive_epic refuses an epic with an in-flight (WORKING) task and writes nothing
  - × /ws UPDATE_EPIC status ARCHIVED must not archive an epic whose task is in flight → AssertionError: expected { epic: 'ARCHIVED', …(2) } to deeply equal { epic: 'ACTIVE', …(2) }. The task stays WORKING, and a spinoff create_task is refused "Epic is ARCHIVED: epic-1 — un-archive the epic first".
  - × /ws UPDATE_EPIC status ARCHIVED on a quiescent epic must shelve its tasks like archive_epic does → AssertionError: expected 'BACKLOG' to be 'ARCHIVED'
- /mnt/d/moe-scratch/hunt-f6f0b580/A/zzHuntA_updateEpicArchive.test.ts (the MCP update_epic path): Tests 2 failed | 2 passed (4).
  - × (r1) update_epic status ARCHIVED with a WORKING row is refused and the epic stays live → promise resolved "{ success: true, epic: { …(10) } }" instead of rejecting
  - × (r2) the live row's worker can still file a bug: card into its own epic → promise rejected "Error: Epic is ARCHIVED: epic-1 — un-arch…"
- Exposure: the live board has 0 ARCHIVED epics today (16 ACTIVE, 18 PLANNED, 2 COMPLETED). The plugin path is one combo change plus Save.

FIX DIRECTION: when update_epic or /ws UPDATE_EPIC moves an epic that is not ARCHIVED to ARCHIVED, run archive_epic's semantics instead of a bare status write: the in-flight refusal, the holder rule for a caller with a workerId, and archiving every task.
- For example, delegate to archiveEpicTool(state).handler({ epicId, workerId }), the way /ws RELEASE_TASK delegates to releaseTaskTool, and apply the remaining fields with updateEpic.
- Leave every other status change, and an already-ARCHIVED epic, unchanged.
- The /ws refusal returns as the usual ERROR frame.

FILES: packages/moe-daemon/src/tools/updateEpic.ts, packages/moe-daemon/src/server/WebSocketServer.ts (the UPDATE_EPIC case only), optionally packages/moe-daemon/src/tools/archiveEpic.ts (to export a shared helper), and a new test such as src/tools/updateEpic.archive.test.ts.
- Placement: WebSocketServer.ts also holds the WebSocket Origin check (hunt #13's lane) and the UPDATE_SETTINGS case, which the approvalMode row may use. Stay inside the UPDATE_EPIC case; worktree merge-tree lands distinct hunks.
- Sync docs/MCP_SERVER.md's `### moe.update_epic` section only if lanes.js shows that file free at planning time.
definitionOfDone: moe.update_epic { status: 'ARCHIVED' } and /ws UPDATE_EPIC { status: 'ARCHIVED' } on an epic with a PLANNING, AWAITING_APPROVAL or WORKING task are refused (NOT_ALLOWED from the tool, an ERROR frame on /ws) and write nothing: the epic keeps its status and every task is unchanged.

On an epic with no in-flight task, both paths leave the epic ARCHIVED and every task ARCHIVED with a TASK_ARCHIVED event, as moe.archive_epic does, and other fields sent in the same call are still applied.
A new vitest file drives both the MCP handler and a /ws UPDATE_EPIC message and passes, and the existing updateEpic, archiveEpic and WebSocketServer tests stay green.
